turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to svc175 while numerous services sharing both the S23–S08 and S08–S15 transport remain healthy. Stable line-interface power, OSNR, BER, DGD and SOP telemetry strongly excludes optical-line, amplifier, span and line-card faults. The paired ODU_TIM alarms at both endpoints most strongly indicate a service-specific ODU cross-connect misconnection, especially at the S08 grooming point between the two lightpaths, but the observations do not localize it to one switch with at least 80% confidence.

proposals.rationale: S08 is the transit/grooming point joining svc175's two lightpaths. A service-specific cross-connect error there explains bilateral ODU_TIM and CLIENT_SF without optical telemetry changes or impact to other ODUs.
